Definition: neuter comparative of the base of G1451; more nearly, i.e. very near:--close.
BiblicalUsage: When the south wind blew softly, the sailors thought their plan had worked, and they sailed close by Crete. The word means near at hand, and it is the calm before the storm that wrecked them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a gentle wind can still carry a ship the wrong way, and closeness to shore is no safety when the storm comes.
